name: Walker Ishbel

intro.text: I'm doing the whole Fife Coastal Path. It's a hundred and something miles. I'm on mile three. There was a very good cafe at mile two.

win: Well walked. Away and get a scone, you've earned it.
after: The haar rolls in off the North Sea on a warm day and you can't see your own boots. The locals call it the haar. The visitors call it 'what is happening'.
